title: Stripe integration: customers and subscriptions
goal: Stripe integration for customers and subscriptions: a typed gateway, workspace-to-customer mapping, subscription persistence and the GET subscription endpoint, with Stripe states mapped to contract statuses.
scope_in: StripeGateway interface and real implementation (pinned Stripe API version, timeouts 10 s, retries on network errors with idempotency keys).
ensureCustomer(workspace): create Stripe customer once per workspace (metadata workspace id, email of owner/billing contact, locale), store stripe_customer_id.

Subscription repository (stripe_subscription_id, plan, status, interval, currency, current_period_start/end, cancel_at_period_end, seats, past_due_since) and mapping Stripe status -> contract status (active, trialing, past_due, canceled, none).
GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/subscription (billing:read; owner, billing, admin) returning plan, status, period, seats, cancel_at_period_end, currency and no card data.
Stripe Tax enabled via automatic_tax on subscriptions; customer tax-id and address pass-through only through the Stripe portal (no storage).
Price catalogue config mapping contract plans (pro, team, seat add-on) x interval x currency to Stripe price ids from env/config.
scope_out: Hosted checkout and portal session creation: B071. Webhook ingestion and state updates from Stripe events: B072.
Seat quantity changes and proration preview: B073.
Entitlement derivation: B069. Invoices endpoint: B077. Trials/coupons: B079.
Storing card numbers or bank details (never; Stripe holds them).
build_against: StripeGateway fake with scripted responses and the official stripe-mock container for HTTP-level tests; no live Stripe keys in tests. Entitlement service via fake port from B069 interface.
interfaces: interface StripeGateway { createCustomer(i, idemKey): Promise<{id}>; retrieveSubscription(id): Promise<StripeSub>; createCheckoutSession(i, idemKey): Promise<{url}>; createPortalSession(i): Promise<{url}>; updateSubscriptionItems(i, idemKey): Promise<StripeSub>; previewInvoice(i): Promise<StripeInvoicePreview>; constructEvent(rawBody, sigHeader): StripeEvent }
BillingService.ensureCustomer(workspaceId): Promise<{customerId}>; getSubscription(workspaceId): Promise<SubscriptionView>; upsertFromStripe(sub: StripeSub): Promise<SubscriptionView>

mapStripeStatus(s: string): 'active'|'trialing'|'past_due'|'canceled'|'none'  // active->active, trialing->trialing, past_due|unpaid->past_due, canceled->canceled, incomplete|incomplete_expired|paused|other->none
GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/subscription -> {workspace, plan, status, interval, currency, period:{start,end}|null, seats:number, cancel_at_period_end:boolean}

Tables billing_customer(workspace_id pk, stripe_customer_id unique, created_at), billing_subscription(workspace_id pk, stripe_subscription_id unique, plan, status, interval, currency, period_start, period_end, seats, cancel_at_period_end, past_due_since, updated_at, stripe_event_created bigint)
acceptance: ensureCustomer called 20 times concurrently for one workspace creates exactly one Stripe customer (idempotency key + unique constraint) and returns the same id.
mapStripeStatus covers every Stripe subscription status value and returns only contract statuses; an unknown future status maps to 'none' with a warning log.
GET subscription by owner, billing and admin returns 200; by member/guest returns 403; by a non-member returns 404; a workspace with no subscription returns {plan:'free', status:'none', period:null}.
The response contains no Stripe ids, card brand/last4, or customer email (key allow-list test).
A Stripe 5xx or timeout on createCustomer is retried up to 3 times with backoff and idempotency key and then returns 503 with retry_after_s; the DB has no half-created row.
Price catalogue lookup for (team, month, EUR) returns the configured price id; a missing combination fails startup config validation in production mode.
upsertFromStripe ignores an update whose Stripe event timestamp is older than the stored stripe_event_created (stale-event guard) and applies a newer one.
guardrails: MUST NOT store or log card data, Stripe secret keys, full Stripe payloads or customer emails beyond the Stripe customer record itself.
MUST send an idempotency key on every Stripe write and derive it deterministically from workspace id + operation.
MUST authorise by workspace role from the DB (owner, billing, admin for read) and never trust a role claim.
MUST pin the Stripe API version in code/config; upgrades are explicit.
Entitlements MUST come from B069, not from Stripe status in route handlers.
failure_modes: Stripe unavailable -> 503 with retry_after_s on write paths; GET subscription serves from the DB and keeps working.
Stripe returns a different currency than recorded -> stored as returned, plan unchanged, warning logged; entitlements unaffected.
Customer exists in Stripe but DB insert failed -> next ensureCustomer finds it by metadata search (workspace id) and links it instead of creating a duplicate.
notes: Size L is fair (gateway + persistence + route). SPLIT? gateway/catalogue vs persistence/route if it overruns. CONTRACT GAP: the subscription response shape is not specified beyond 'Subscription state (active|trialing|past_due|canceled)'; the 'free/none' view for unsubscribed workspaces is this lane's proposal.
